text:
emma (partnerships): Quick check-in — aiming to have all three cloud marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure) in staging by EOW. High level: publisher account, legal artifacts, pricing/SKU map, AMI/container images, screenshots, and billing tags. Who can own what?

toby (eng): I can take AMI/container image IDs + sample deployment artifacts. Will produce a single artifacts manifest that files per-cloud under images[]. Also will add a minimal terraform example for the marketplace publisher upload.

priya (legal): I'll take EULA + privacy addendum redline. Need product to confirm exact telemetry fields (names + retention) so I can list them in the privacy blurb. Also FYI: Azure requires localized storefront copy for FR/DE/JA. Translation turnaround ~ 72 hours.

nate (ops): From billing side we need metering headers + mapping: X-RW-TENANT, rz-sku, region, usage_kind (inference|embeddings). Confirming we can accept a header fallback of customer-id in case tenant header missing. Also need an example payload for meter ping.

clara (marketing): I'll prepare short description, 3 bullets (use-cases), and a single onboarding GIF + 3 screenshots. Need staging UI with fake org/org id so screenshots don't capture live data.

emma (partnerships): Proposal: default trial 14 days, dev tier and pro tier, trial entitlements tied to sku "trial-001". Approve?

toby (eng): 14 days works. For SKUs I'd prefer: SKU format RW-<product>-<tier>-<cloud>. But publisher portals like consolidated SKUs. I'll output a mapping file: sku -> {display_name, cloud_variants, pricing_unit}.

priya (legal): OK on 14 days. I'll add explicit marketplace refund window per cloud in the EULA redline. Also need to confirm telemetry retention: product?

emma (partnerships): @toby @nate @clara please sync offline if any blocker. I'll book a 20m slot tomorrow 11am PT to finalize owners.

deploy-bot: staging-publisher account created: publisher_id=p-99887, console=https://staging-pub.redwood.example/login — credentials DM'ed. :white_check_mark:

priya (legal): Uploading baseline redline to https://internal.redwood/legal/marketplace/eula-redline-3187654321.docx. Will flag any cloud-specific clauses inline.

toby (eng): artifacts manifest draft uploaded: https://internal.redwood/s3/marketplace/manifests/3187654321-artifacts.json — includes aws.amis, gcp.images, azure.blobs, and sample container digests. Example snippet: 

```
{"sku": "RW-NLP-pro-aws", "aws_amis": ["ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f"], "gcr_images": ["gcr.io/redwood/runner@sha256:abcd..."], "azure_manifests": ["registry.azurecr.io/redwood/runner:sha-xyz"]}
```

nate (ops): Metering example added to billing doc: https://internal.redwood/ops/billing/marketplace-metering.md — will require X-RW-TENANT header and json body {"sku":"RW-NLP-pro-aws","units":1234,"region":"us-west-2"}.

clara (marketing): I'll stage placeholder screenshots in /s3/marketing/staging-screens/3187654321. Once eng provides staging images I'll swap them.

priya (legal): One more ask: can product confirm we don't send any raw customer prompts to marketplace telemetry? If so we must explicitly state that in privacy addendum.

toby (eng): We send aggregated usage metrics and token counts. We do NOT send raw prompts to the publisher feed. I'll put a short note in the artifacts manifest metadata: telemetry: {"sends_raw_prompts":false,"metrics": ["token_count","latency_ms"]}.

emma (partnerships): Great. Owners summary: toby -> artifacts + deploy snippets, priya -> EULA + localizations, nate -> billing/meters, clara -> marketing assets, me -> overall listing coordination + partner handoff. Meeting tomorrow 11am PT to close. Thanks all :rocket:
